import pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt

go = pd.DataFrame([
 ["GO:0004252","serine-type endopeptidase activity","MF","IEA:UniProtKB-EC","SUPPORTED (core MF) - retain"],
 ["GO:0031639","plasminogen activation","BP","IEA:TreeGrafter","SUPPORTED (core BP) - retain"],
 ["GO:0005576","extracellular region","CC","IEA:UniProtKB-SubCell","SUPPORTED - retain"],
 ["GO:0048008","PDGF receptor signaling pathway","BP","IEA:TreeGrafter","OVER-ANNOTATED - remove/non-core"],
 ["GO:0014909","smooth muscle cell migration","BP","IEA:TreeGrafter","OVER-ANNOTATED - remove/non-core"],
 ["GO:0033993","response to lipid","BP","IEA:UniProtKB-ARBA","WEAK - remove/non-core"],
 ["GO:1901701","cellular response to oxygen-containing compound","BP","IEA:UniProtKB-ARBA","WEAK - remove/non-core"],
], columns=["GO_ID","Term","Aspect","Evidence","Assessment"])
go.to_csv("/tmp/K9IJK6_GO_decision_table.csv", index=False)

arch = pd.DataFrame([
 ["Human tPA (PLAT)","F-E-K1-K2-P","yes","yes","2"],
 ["DSPA-alpha1 (desmoteplase)","F-E-K-P","yes","yes","1"],
 ["DSPA-beta","E-K-P","no","yes","1"],
 ["DSPA-gamma / K9IJK6","K-P","no","no","1"],
], columns=["Protein","Architecture","Finger","EGF","Kringles"])
arch.to_csv("/tmp/K9IJK6_domain_comparison.csv", index=False)

seq=""
print("length:",len(seq),"| triad H189=",seq[188],"D238=",seq[237],"S345=",seq[344],
      "| GDSGGP@",seq.find("GDSGGP")+1)
print(go.to_string(index=False))
print()
print(arch.to_string(index=False))

# provenance figure: GO decision table
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(13,3.2)); ax.axis("off")
colors=[]
for a in go["Assessment"]:
    if a.startswith("SUPPORTED"): colors.append("#c8e6c9")
    elif a.startswith("OVER"): colors.append("#ffcdd2")
    else: colors.append("#fff9c4")
tbl=ax.table(cellText=go.values, colLabels=go.columns, cellLoc="left", loc="center")
tbl.auto_set_font_size(False); tbl.set_fontsize(8); tbl.scale(1,1.5)
for i,c in enumerate(colors):
    tbl[(i+1,4)].set_facecolor(c)
ax.set_title("K9IJK6 (DSPA-gamma) GO annotation curation assessment — all process terms IEA (electronic)",fontweight="bold")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig("/tmp/K9IJK6_GO_decision.png",dpi=140,bbox_inches="tight"); plt.show()
print("\nartifacts: /tmp/K9IJK6_GO_decision_table.csv, /tmp/K9IJK6_domain_comparison.csv, /tmp/K9IJK6_GO_decision.png")
